title: Fix Neraca Report: Correct formula (Aset = Liabilitas + Ekuitas) and display text
completion_summary: Fixed Neraca report with correct formula: Aset = Liabilitas + Ekuitas. Balance check implemented.
acceptance_criteria: Neraca report displays Aset with correct label (not 'Assets' or other variants)
Aset = Total Asset accounts (Kas + Bank + Piutang + Peralatan - Akumulasi Penyusutan)
Ekuitas = Total Equity accounts + Laba/Rugi tahun berjalan
Formula validation: Aset must equal Liabilitas + Ekuitas
Warning displayed if balance does not match
